`sample.db` is a SafeInCloud database (password `foobar`) from
[mxschmitt/golang-safe-in-cloud](https://github.com/mxschmitt/golang-safe-in-cloud)
(`decrypt_test.db`), MIT licensed, © 2017 Max Schmitt; the license is in `LICENSE`.
It holds German sample cards: labels, templates, a passport, a Visa card, a note and
four logins.
